meal.title: Reading whole lines with fgets
meal.objective: Use fgets to read a full line of text including spaces

voice.script: Can you read a sentence with spaces? How do you capture a full line of user input? In C, the function fgets lets you pull an entire line from the keyboard, stopping at a newline or when the buffer fills. First we create a character array to hold the text. Then we call fgets, giving it the array, its size, and the standard input stream. After the call, the array contains everything the user typed, spaces and all. Finally we display the captured line with printf. Here is the program. When you run it, you can type a sentence and see it printed back. Use fgets to read an entire line, including spaces.
